title: Samieh Y NDE 8664/8558
content: 8664: I was on my way back to our town, when I started having a seizure. I found myself in a very vast and dark place, but I still could see. I was not aware of my body anymore. I asked a lot of questions, like where am I and how I came here? But there was no answer. Then I realized that there is a void under me as well because I was not standing on anything. I mean the feeling we have on Earth that there is always something under your feet. That feeling was not there. Then I saw a very beautiful light that was shining on me even though it was far away from me. My surroundings and environment were still dark. In a strange way I received this understanding that everything will be all right. Suddenly, I opened my eyes and saw that I was on a hospital bed. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 1999 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes While under general anesthesia. Life threatening event, but not clinical death. Seizure and lack of oxygen to brain How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? No How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. I think it was normal At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I saw the light Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual. It felt like I was there for weeks. Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I felt my sight was more acute than normal Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Didn’t hear anything Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes It was more vast than a tunnel, but it looked like a tunnel. I was in a vast darkness that was infinite. Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an unearthly light? Yes I saw a light that gave me the feeling of security and peace. I felt like I am at the right and good place. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Some unfamiliar and strange place. I never thought I would be standing while not feeling anything under me. What emotions did you feel during the experience? I was very confused but was not feeling worried at all. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No I cCannot remember, unfortunately. Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Muslim Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Muslim Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. Honestly, I was a kid and didn’t have much of a religious or spiritual belief. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes I like to think the light I saw was the light of God Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life. For example: After the experience, I could hear a voice in my head that helped me during my math exam. One time in middle of the night before falling asleep, the voice was whispering and calling my name. This was scaring me and I begged [God] to stop it and it ended. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I do not know how my remembrance of the experience compares to my remembrance of other life events at the time. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes At first my family didn’t believe me, but now their opinion has shifted. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was probably not real. Nobody believed me. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely not real. Because I compared it with other NDE experiences on this site. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes One time I got out of my body when I was in a very bad situation. I could see my body from 360 degree, but still could not recognize it. Experience Description 8558: My family and I were travelling to my hometown. It was a car trip in the middle of summer with no air-conditioning. I started to feel sleepy, so I laid my head on my aunt's lap. My parents noticed that I had an absence seizure and had stopped breathing. I don't remember if I was looking at my own body. But I do remember being in a cave-like place. It was so dark. I thought it was odd that I was standing on nothing. I asked so many questions but no one answered. I remember wondering if it was a prison or something. I was so confused. Then, I saw a bright light at the end of this place. The light was very pleasant and I stopped worrying about where I was or what was going to happen. Then I was jolted back into my body. I was in the hospital and seeing the faces of my freaked-out parents. A few months later, I began hearing sounds echoing in my mind. I don't know who it was but it was helping me in my math problems at school. The sounds didn't allow me to sleep at night. I was so scared and no one ever believed me. I begged the voice to stop talking and it did. Now I regret that, but now it's too late. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 1999 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Absence Seizure. Life threatening event, but not clinical death How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I saw a bright pleasant light that I've never seen before. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. It was like life on earth. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I lost consciousness of my body Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual. I felt like I was there for weeks. Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Normal Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I don't remember hearing anything Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes. It was a non-ending cave, like a realm of darkness Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes the light shined on me, but not on the darkness - to my surprise. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Some unfamiliar and strange place. It was a new place where I was standing on nothing. The light didn't light up the darkness What emotions did you feel during the experience? confused Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Muslim Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I trust God more than I used to, because we shared a minute of trust. What is your religion now? Muslim Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Uncertain I was a child, so I didn't care Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes I think I saw the light of God himself Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I felt like the light was my best friend During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life. I didn't know I actually went to another dimension. Just because my parents told me that my experience wasn't real, I didn't take it seriously. But now that I've read hundreds of NDEs, I wish I had. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Uncertain I was nine years old. I told my parents about my experience but they said I had a vivid imagination How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I used to hear a whispering Male voice in my head helping me in math at school and scaring me to death. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? The light had such a great communication with me and made me so cheered up that I felt like a grown-up understanding something great. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes my family. They didn't believe me back then. But now they say it's not impossible. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was probably real. I don't remember everything about it but it was really confusing to me What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. I was there and it wasn't a dream because I actually stopped breathing At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes I had an out of body experience in 2012 and looked at my body from above and all around. Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? no Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? you should have a comment section so we can ask NDEs our own questions.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Described as a vast, infinite darkness / cave-like place; 'more vast than a tunnel' and 'non-ending cave, like a realm of darkness.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Vast/dark place or cave-like darkness; experiencer felt there was a void under them/standing on nothing; light shone on them but did not illuminate the darkness.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Seizure/absence seizure with stopped breathing and lack of oxygen to brain; one account also says 'while under general anesthesia.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Dark, cave-like/void environment; standing on nothing; asking questions with no answer; comforting understanding from the light.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience emphasizes being in vast darkness/void first, then seeing a distant bright light that brought calm; return to body followed.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Light shone on the experiencer but did not illuminate the surrounding darkness; post-NDE ongoing internal 'voice/sounds' helping with math and whispering/calling their name until they begged it to stop.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was standing on nothing.” “I saw a bright light at the end of this place… The light was very pleasant and I stopped worrying about where I was or what was going to happen.”
